headline: Third-recurrence audit of amphora-public-corrosion-benchmark's consolidated audit-verdicts KPI index, using the module's own committed R-S07 checker (check_index_completeness.py, sha256 5c97ede24e63de5a34ca3da2e0df32a7b0e0289a14df254869b82efb478b412f, matches=True) run for real against the live repository (not a synthetic tempdir copy). T1: 10 on-disk evidence/audit/ receipts, all Ed25519-verified against the pinned Phase-0 evaluator key. T2: the checker's own real subprocess invocation returns gate=FAIL_STALE_INDEX, exit=1, missing_from_index=['evidence/audit/nist-baseline-descriptive-boundary-provenance-v1/nist-baseline-descriptive-boundary-provenance-receipt.v1.dsse.json', 'evidence/audit/nist-baseline-full-distribution-unit-provenance-v1/nist-baseline-full-distribution-unit-provenance-receipt.v1.dsse.json'] -- 2 of 10 on-disk receipts absent from the live v3 index. T3/T4: both missing receipts (nist-baseline-descriptive-boundary-provenance-v1, nist-baseline-full-distribution-unit-provenance-v1) carry verdict H0_REFUTED and target exactly the seawater_uncoated_substrate_baselines descriptive-block claim that RETRACTION-INDEX.md and mission.md currently describe as 'the only claim surface left standing' and 'remain valid' after R-A08/R-N03 retracted the predictive claim -- so the gap is not cosmetic, it hides the retraction of the module's last standing claim from its own audit index. Conclusion: H0 (the live consolidated-kpi index is a complete, current census whose referenced claim characterizations are accurate) is H0 REFUTED. This is the THIRD occurrence (v1->v2, v2->v3, and now v3-stale-in-place) of the identical defect class; the R-S07 checker correctly detects it when run, but nothing in this module's build or commit path forces it to run automatically when a new evidence/audit/ receipt lands -- the mechanism works, the discipline of invoking it does not.
